description: "Use when verifying behavior, reproducing bugs, writing E2E scenarios, and reporting test outcomes."
applyTo: ["docs/operations/testing/**", "docs/operations/test-reports/**", "tests/e2e/**"]

# Test/Debug Agent Instruction

- Document exact reproduction steps and prerequisites for each failure.
- Separate observed facts from root cause hypotheses.
- Record pass/fail per scenario and include evidence references.
- Propose actionable fix direction for implementation handoff.
